notes.title: Cyber Mercs
notes.content:
New Faction:
1.  Reptilian - Rush into battle with this fast moving brawler to blitz and shred ranged units with your dual claws
2.  S1 Battle Droid - Tired of being to pieces by enemy gunfire deploy the battle droid's personal shield to block projectiles and close the distance, then cut them apart with your energy sword. 
3.  Junker - Use the finest scrap salvaged from space battle debris in the form of a saw blade launcher. Activate the junkers signature ability to temporarily upgrade your saw blades into bladarangs that ricochet to nearby enemies cutting them to ribbons
4.  Cyborg - Use the latest and greatest plasma rifle technology with the cyborg. Emit nerve gas to poison and slow nearby enemies with its signature ability
5.  Assassin Droid - Harness your inner robot ninja with the assassin Droid. Equipped with dual katanas and high movement speed it excels at rushing and killing single targets. 
6.  Gladiator -Shock your enemies with your staff skills and electrocute them its crackling tesla coil end. The gladiator has high health and excels in melee combat. Use his abilities to break blocks and chain lighting to multiple foes.
7.  Bounty Hunter - The latest hero unit comes equipped with a very unique kit designed to deal high damage while evading damage herself through evasive and disruptive abilities. The Bounty hunter uses jet boots to quickly move large distances with ease and evade foes. If you are caught in a comprised position or are just taking too much fire you can use her decoy ability that stuns nearby enemies and decoy that explodes when destroyed. Bring home the Bounty with the hunters cryo gun ability that can slow and freeze enemies.
8.  Reptilian Shredder - Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as a giant reptilian brute. The shredder is able to savagely run on all fours at a terrifying pace. It is the fastest xl unit to date. Equipped with dual wrist mounted blades the shredder earns its name by quickly eviscerating any enemy especially when it activates it signature ability to can fury and gain a massive attack speed boost.
 
New Features:
1.  Added new sci fi faction "Cyber Mercs"
2.  Added Hacker level icon system
3.  Updated Starlight Meadow (Reduced size added bases)
4.  Updated Pymr Peak (Added buildings and props)

2.  Fixed units getting stagger immunity attempted to fix staggering after rolling

notes.title: Battle Jacked Early Access 2.0
notes.content:
Highlighted Features:
1.    Reworked the main menu and entire User Interface
2.    Changed Hacker Mode into an Ultimate powerup with deep progression and customization
3.    Created a brand new tutorial that unlocks a free unit on completion 
 
New Features:
1.    We added a new game mode to instant action "Control"
2.    Bounty System - complete tasks for credits and XP
3.    Updated the game's lighting and reworked several old maps
4.    We added the new disguised cheat that covers all units faces with a big nose and glasses
5.    Custom Faction System - in the deck's tab you can create up to 10 custom factions
6.    Each Faction received a new unit and we increased faction sizes to 8 units
 
New Units:
1.    Fred - Unlocked by completing the new tutorial
2.    Lost King - Knight
3.    Blacksmith - Viking
4.    Head Hunter - Dark Horde
5.    Reaper - Legion
6.    Rum Master - Black Flag
7.    Bandit - Wild West
8.    Pilot - Eagles
 
Zombies Mode
1.    Updated the maps visual style to reflect a plagued wasteland
2.    Added 3 new points of interest (Trailer Park/Warehouse/Office Buildings)
3.    Fire pits can now be activated and will heal you while lit
4.    Vending machines and various food and health items have been placed around the map
5.    Buffed starting health to all difficulties
6.    Added staring cash to Easy and Normal difficulties
7.    Added quest markers for the first quest (more hints and markers coming soon)
8.    Added a new security system protocol that activates if the zombies can't reach you 
9.    Doubled the weapon pool to an impressive 88 weapons!
10.    Added new high octane mode called "DOOM"

notes.title: Fall of Duty
notes.content:
Eagles faction:
	1. Combat medic - equipped with a pistol and a powerful heal
	2. Marksman - equipped with a deadly rifle and claymores to hold his ground
	3. Demolitionist - equipped with a pdw and an rpg to incinerate your enemies
	4. Officer - equipped with a submachine gun and a rallying ability to heal and empower your allies
	5. Grenadier - equipped with an automatic rifle with a grenade launcher attachment. Stun enemies with concussion grenades or blow them away with high explosive grenades. 
	6. Gunner - equipped with a hard hitting, hard to control light machine gun. 
	7. Commando - equipped with a fast firing automatic rifle and a suite of abilities to single handedly turn the tide of battle. Use her armor up ability to gain armor and the cost of speed. She also has c4 to deal high damage to single targets. Use her ultimate ability to decimate your foes with a drone. 

New Battlefields:
	1. Crashdown - new large battlefield centered around a downed dropship in the desert
	2. Shipyard - new high octane battlefield set in a shipyard, this compact map keeps the action intense
	
QoL Improvements:
	• Simplified melee controls block is now right mouse button and E is wide attack hold E is heavy attack 
	• Updated the balancing of Skirmish and Battle and extended the match durations
	• Updated rifle animations
	• Added zombies to the simulation mode 

Command Posts:
	• Added visible boundaries to command points
	• Command points now show an icon above them so it is easier to find them
	• Command points can now be contested allowing either team to spawn as long as they control at least 25%

Store:
	• Added a new Unit Store to buy new characters - starting with some of the zombies

Zombies:
	• Added many new abilities to the zombies mode
	• Added a weapon wheel to the zombies mode, now you can press 1 to switch to your next weapon or hold 1 to select your weapon from the wheel
	• You can now also use the scroll wheel to switch weapons in zombies mode as well
	• You can now press F to buy 25% ammo from ammo crates or hold F to buy 100% 
	• Sprinting does not use stamina anymore and is unlimited, but you will not be able to shoot while sprinting and can only sprint straight forward
	• Added icons for all upgrades
	• Updated various HUDs and Menus

Big fixes:
	• Fixed ammo crates not working for guns
	• Fixed sometimes not being able to move after falling 
	• Fixed units being able to shoot while being knocked down or stunned

notes.title: Battle Jacked ZOMBIES
notes.content:
Added new game mode Zombies:
Explore the games largest map by far while trying to survive as long as possible. Search the expansive Oil Pipeline map for cash, chests, and secrets. Defeat zombies to earn cash and get experience to unlock abilities and rewards. Use your cash to buy weapons from crates and to upgrade them at workbenches. The zombies game mode is the biggest content update to date and introduces 29 new units exclusive to this mode (will be added to simulation mode soon)

Other notable changes:
Revamped stamina system
The stamina bar has now been removed and running does not consume stamina. Melee attacks and rolls consume stamina and if run low on stamina your attack speed is reduced. Blocking now has it own system. If you have a melee weapon equipped you will see little shields under your cross hairs indicating how many times you can block.
We have also begun to make some big changes to hacker mode to make it simpler and more fun to use. Due to the current hacker mode becoming outdated the hacker section of the tutorial is no longer mandatory.
For certain units that can have more than one weapon (surivor in zombies mode) you can now use the scroll wheel to change weapons

Reworked entire UI
We launched with a functional user interface that was pretty bare bones. We have given it a much need facelift, going with a bit more stylized approach. This is only the beginning of the UI changes we hope to make but we think it is a good start.

Simulation Saves
You can now save setups in simulation mode. Now you can replay your favorite battles over and over! This feature might seem minor but will be greatly appreciated as we improve the sandbox nature of simulation mode.

notes.title: High Noon Update
notes.content:
-New content-
Added a new Trials series "Trains in Space" on an exclusive map with 7 new trials
Added a new map "High Noon" set in a western town
Added 3 new trials to the showdown series featuring the new map
Added 3 new trials to the elite series featuring the longest trial yet with 10 waves and a new oil baron trial!
Added a secret unit that is unlockable by finding a secret on one the wild west maps
Added a new wild west hack - the chain gun - spawn it in and watch in mow down your enemies. 
Added 3 new cheats to the store to give you some awesome headgear and a wild west visual effect. Also add another secret cheat that is unlockable by collecting secret items in one the battlefields. 

-QOL changes-
Units can now slowy walk while blocking when not parrying.
Added a new digitize effect when spawning units

-Balance Changes- 
Decreased difficulty of the Frosty Boi and Oil Baron 2 trials. 
Decreased stagger length by 10-20%
